name: Visceral Inversion: the defender shrinks the attacking ally by 5 POWER so the attack deals no damage
notes: Player 1 answers player 2's Dungeon Guide attack (power 1) with Visceral Inversion from hand. The handler read the attacker-relative CombatAttacker variable in the defender's frame and never found the attacker; the Dungeon Guide now gets -5 POWER until end of turn and the attack deals nothing.

rulesClauses: Target attacking ally gets -5 POWER until end of turn.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Visceral Inversion resolved the attacking ally in the wrong frame when used by the defending player.
